transcript.text: Back in 2025 I did that quick hop from Beijing down to Shanghai, and I remember thinking the whole rail setup between those two cities was way smoother than I expected.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that same year I was in Chongqing for a weekend, and everyone kept arguing about which theaters there were actually worth it.

transcript.text: For that Beijing–Shanghai run, my coworker had already gotten me on train G1, and it was all under the name Mike Davis.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Chongqing, my friend Song Qi had already bought two tickets for Kung Fu Panda 4 at CGV Raffles City—the showtime was 11:30, which felt ridiculously early for a movie.
